author: opt-W5

contract.sync_assumed: warp convergence of the 32 lanes, the caller separates calls that reuse the output buffer or the temp storage by a __syncwarp (the harness does)
contract.sync_performed: one redux.min for the threshold, log2(IPT + 1) ballots for the prefix, one __syncwarp between the scatter and the gather, one redux.max per finish round, one redux.max for the fp32 next-word check (redux.add, max and min on the fp32 slow path, redux.add per level and two ballots per item on the overflow fallback), no barriers
contract.n_range: N = 32 x IPT, power of two, 256 to 65536 (bf16) or 32768 (fp32), measured 512 to 2048
contract.type_constraints: as W5_v2: float filter, W2 finish word (bf16 exact, fp32 idea N4 on buffer positions with the exact tie pass), int32 indices from the striped position
contract.nan_behavior: as W5_v2 (a NaN never passes the float filter), focus-set inputs contain no NaN
contract.tie_break_support: inherent (finish word and fallback tickets), same code for both requirements
contract.sorted_output_support: descending by key on the filter path (fp32 by truncated key with the tie class rewritten), ticket order on the overflow fallback

low_level: Predicate-free flags (sign bit of a - t as an integer 0 or 1, integer count tree, unconditional stores with a per-lane dummy slot) cut the compare-and-count phase from 314 to 98 cycles at bf16 N 1024 k 32 and from 836 to 194 at N 2048 (phase profiler approaches/W5/phase_probe3.cu against phase_probe.cu, same inputs), the scatter phase stayed at 332 (v2 341) and the gather at 440 (v2 446). Whole call against W5_v2 in the same lock section: bf16 N 1024 k 8 1173 vs 1358, k 32 2116 vs 2279, N 2048 k 8 1675 vs 2126, k 16 2018 vs 2535, k 32 2675 vs 3094, k 64 4427 vs 5106, fp32 N 2048 k 16 2256 vs 2592, k 32 3296 vs 3728, N 512 within 5 percent.

The scatter costs about 10 cycles per store instruction at every IPT (184 to 191 for 16 stores, 332 to 352 for 32, 611 to 668 for 64), whether the stores are predicated (v2) or unconditional with a dummy slot (v3), so the shared store instruction count is the cost and not the active lanes. The bf16 gather costs 430 to 530 cycles for 8 loads at every N against 170 to 220 for the fp32 gather of the same shape: the bf16 word construction twiddles each gathered word with W2's twiddle (one compare and one select per word for the minus-zero normalization) under the `p < tot` predicate of each position, which is the predicate serialization of v2 again.

Registers grew to 128 at N 1024 (v2 72) and 249 to 255 at N 2048 (v2 128 bf16 and 168 fp32) with no spill: the unconditional scatter lets ptxas hoist the flag and address arithmetic of every item before the stores. Throughput therefore drops 1 to 15 percent against v2 (bf16 N 2048 k 16 1187 vs 1389 Gelem per s) while it stays 1.31x to 2.64x over W2.
Canary 32.001 at start and end, R squared 1.0000 in every cell, no local memory.
algorithmic: Decomposition at bf16 N 1024 k 32 (2497 profiled cycles): loads 258, per-lane top 2 162, group merge and threshold 80, count 98, ballot prefix 216, scatter 332, gather 440, sort 74, rounds 837. The rounds are W2's and the loads are the harness's, so the W5-specific fixed cost is about 1400 of which the scatter and the gather are 770. The threshold itself (bound family of the W5_base card) is 240 cycles.
negative: Unconditional stores to a dummy slot do not make the scatter cheaper than predicated stores and cost 56 to 125 more registers at N 1024 to 2048, a throughput loss with no latency gain in the scatter phase itself (the latency gain of v3 comes from the count phase).
surprises: Two phases with the same instruction count per item (count and scatter, 3 to 5 instructions) differ by a factor 3 in cycles once the predicates are gone, so the shared store instruction is the unit of cost of the compaction: about 10 cycles per STS on one warp, consistent with T12's 4 stores plus 4 loads at 82 cycles.
open_questions: Whether the bf16 gather drops to the fp32 level with a compare-free twiddle (minus zero normalized at load by one FADD) and a mask instead of the position predicate (v4 is built to answer this).
Whether the store count can be halved by storing two candidates of a lane per 64-bit store when the lane's run start is even, with zero holes otherwise, and what the holes cost in list depth.
Whether a blocked arrangement with 16-byte vector loads changes the load phase (258 cycles at IPT 32 in the profile, inside the generate-only control in the harness).

correctness_notes: oracle battery passed on every cell of both batches, the overflow fallback is exercised by the tie_heavy, pivot_tie, all_equal and sorted cases, inf_denorm passes with the sign-bit flags.
